severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — ACOUSTIC INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: SYNTHETIC-AUDIO FRONT FLOODS THE SPOTIFY LOWLANDS AS AI-GENERATED 'ARTISTS' WITH NO FACE, NO BAND, AND NO PULSE STOCK EVERY MELLOW PLAYLIST WITH FRICTIONLESS FILLER ENGINEERED TO BE HEARD BY NO ONE AND SKIPPED BY NO ONE
advisory: A slow-moving mass of generated ambient product has settled over the streaming regions and is not expected to lift. Residents seeking 'Peaceful Piano' or 'Deep Focus' are advised that the artist they are listening to may have released four hundred tracks this quarter, toured nowhere, and been born on a server Tuesday. The Service reminds the public that royalties are finite and that every stream of a phantom is a stream withheld from someone who owns a real guitar. Take shelter in a discography with liner notes.

regional_outlook.conditions: Total saturation. Generated instrumentals pooling to a depth of ten thousand tracks per playlist, with a low ceiling of any discernible artist behind them.
Persistent updrafts of 'lo-fi beats to study to' loops, most authored by accounts with no channel history and a suspiciously round upload count.
Queries for the phantom artist's 'biography' return AI-written pages confirming a life story assembled, like the music, from nothing.
Distribution-service newsletters promising residents they too can upload two hundred tracks a month; slop advisory in effect for anyone tempted.
Scattered 'AI song generator' apps drifting in, each offering to fill your feed with music no human requested and no human wrote.

specimen.status: Explosively common; multiplying faster than any playlist can be curated.
specimen.habitat: Mood-based and activity-based playlists — study, sleep, focus, 'jazz for a rainy afternoon' — where listeners do not look at the screen and therefore never check who is playing.
specimen.field_marks: A profile picture that is either a foggy landscape or an empty chair; a release schedule of impossible density; zero tour dates, zero interviews, zero fans who can name a single song.
specimen.call: You've been listening for three hours and never once wondered whose hands these are — that's the idea, friend, that's the whole idea.
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a genuinely prolific independent composer. Tell them apart by the human details: a real artist eventually thanks a bandmate, misses a release date, or posts a photo of a cluttered studio. The phantom never tires, never apologizes, and never records anything twice.

spotter_tip: If a 'lo-fi' artist has released more hours of music this year than there are hours in the year, you are not looking at a person — you are looking at a faucet someone left running.
tomorrow: Continued heavy audio slop, with generated 'sleep sounds' migrating into podcast regions overnight; skip button of limited use.

confirmed_sighting.report: An empirical research paper posted to arXiv measures the prevalence and impact of AI-generated 'slop' flooding music streaming services, documenting how synthetic tracks are spreading across the platforms residents use to listen. The Service notes that the phantoms are now large enough to be counted.
